name: Anchorite Delan
summary: Anchorite Delan is a draenei priest stationed inside Darkshire Town Hall in Duskwood. Hearing of the blighted forest's pervasive undeath and malevolent shadows, he traveled here to offer the Light's guidance and aid the embattled townspeople.

sections.title: A Light in the Shadows
sections.body: When word reached the draenei of Duskwood's dire predicament—a realm suffocated by creeping shadows, ravenous beasts, and relentless undead—Anchorite Delan took it upon himself to journey south. Stationing himself within the Darkshire Town Hall alongside local administrators, he works tirelessly to offer the holy solace of the Light to the beleaguered citizenry. Coordinating alongside representatives like Emissary Taluun, Delan directs willing travelers to lend a hand wherever the town's beleaguered Night Watch cannot stretch.

faq.answer: Anchorite Delan is a draenei priest residing in Darkshire Town Hall. Moved by accounts of the encroaching undead and dark magic menacing Duskwood, he journeyed to the town to help the residents resist the lingering evil.

Among the draenei, an anchorite is a dedicated priest and spiritual guide devoted to the Holy Light. They minister to the spiritual welfare of their people and actively battle unholy forces and despair.

faq.q: Why did Anchorite Delan come to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Delan came to Darkshire specifically to counter the undeath and darkness plaguing the region. Duskwood's desperate struggles drew him to offer spiritual protection and direct able-bodied adventurers to assist the embattled locals.

faq.q: How is Delan connected to Emissary Taluun?
faq.answer: Emissary Taluun directs travelers from Stormwind toward Darkshire to meet Delan. Upon their arrival, Delan urges these adventurers to protect the citizens and turn back the shadows menacing the region.

angles.text: Priests will recognize a fellow devotee of the Light in Delan, who chose to bring comfort and holy protection to one of the most haunted and dangerous settlements in the Eastern Kingdoms.
Delan represents the bonds forming between the newly arrived draenei and established Alliance communities, stepping forward to aid human settlements in dire need.
